name: Stamford American International School
summary: American and IB programmes across Woodleigh and Mont Kiara-adjacent pathways in Singapore.
body: Stamford American offers American curriculum elements alongside IB, with modern campuses oriented toward families wanting US-style facilities. Check current campus configuration and bus routes — geography matters as much as curriculum fit.
waitlistNotes: Inquire by grade; mid-year seats depend on attrition.
